{{Top|leg}}
'''TraitWare''' was the official name given to physical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] components. TraitWare was hardwired into the droid chassis<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> and described abilities including intelligence, strength, speed, and technical skills. These specific talents were fleshed out by [[SkillWare]].<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
